Highland Paws.text: My fussy lab finishes the bowl in minutes. First kibble he has never left over.
Stools firm and much less smell after two weeks on the salmon formula.
Coat noticeably shinier in a month. Worth the extra money.
Great food but pricey. The 6kg pack makes it more reasonable.
Love that it is grain-free with real chicken first. Vet recommended.
Food is great but the zip on the pack broke on arrival.
Puppy took to it quickly, kibble size is just right.
Salmon variant smells quite strong, my pug was not impressed.
Switched from a big brand, no tummy upset at all.

Mewsli.text: My cat goes crazy for the tuna lick treat. Perfect for giving medicine.
Tofu litter is nearly dust free and clumps well. Smell control is good.
Litter is a bit pricey but lasts longer than clay.
Treat pouch tore at the seal, some leaked in the box.
Both my cats like the chicken crunchy ones.
Green tea scent is too strong, my cat refused to use it at first.
Silica crystals did not track at all, very clean.
Bentonite litter clumps fine but is a bit dusty.

SnapTail.text: Rope toy frayed within a week with my beagle.
Squeaker stopped working in two days. Cheap quality.
Decent value for the price, the harness fits well.
Collar buckle felt flimsy, packaging was just a polybag.
Cat loves the feather wand, the bell is a bit loud.
Rubber bone has a strong chemical smell, returned it.
Leash lock jammed after a month.
Bowl is solid and anti-skid works. Cheaper than most.

Verdant Tails.text: Neem shampoo worked great against ticks, smells natural.
Paw balm smells lovely and my dog does not lick it off.
Bottle leaked in transit, cap does not seal properly.
A bit expensive for the quantity.
Turmeric chews did not help my old dog's joints in a month despite the claims.
Oat honey biscuits disappear in seconds.
Shampoo made my dog's skin itchier. Stopped using it.
No batch or expiry date printed clearly on the probiotic pack.
